readout.invariant_readout: logpower mean/std,lag1/2 normalized complex correlation,4 positional logpower means
readout.interpretation: Received relative filter/polynomial energy is retained by normalization;not recovered TX PA/IQ coefficients or arbitrary RX/channel invariance
readout.normalization_scope: one complex power mean across all channels and time per packet per block
readout.relative_energy_after_gate: may change through learned radial gate;not fixed
readout.waveform_operator: x[n]exp(-j alpha omega n);raw variant returns x exactly
readout.alignment_interpretation: fixed received frequency retention;not TX/RX oscillator proportion
readout.behavior_input: lag4 envelope control plus signed tanh-gated delayed cubic residual
readout.mixture_scope: two global identity model parameters trained only by source CE
readout.initial_function: exact own scratch neural_residual_shallow; isolated new initialization RNG
readout.neural_shared_gain: one RMS over complex channels and time per packet
readout.relation_exit: biasfree Linear384to16 then biasfree Linear16to320; no activation
readout.readout_skip: complete original320 InvariantReadout retained independently in both paths
readout.readout_exit_initialization: zero final projection; random earlier projections
readout.readout_scope: one received packet; common finite lag window; no cross-packet statistics/state
readout.relation_gain_property: positive per-projected-channel gain invariance above floors
readout.gain_property_scope: relation statistics after projections only; not the whole model or arbitrary physical channel

readout.invariant_readout: logpower mean/std,lag1/2 normalized complex correlation,4 positional logpower means
readout.interpretation: Received relative filter/polynomial energy is retained by normalization;not recovered TX PA/IQ coefficients or arbitrary RX/channel invariance
readout.normalization_scope: one complex power mean across all channels and time per packet per block
readout.relative_energy_after_gate: may change through learned radial gate;not fixed
readout.waveform_operator: x[n]exp(-j alpha omega n);raw variant returns x exactly
readout.alignment_interpretation: fixed received frequency retention;not TX/RX oscillator proportion
readout.behavior_input: lag4 envelope control plus signed tanh-gated delayed cubic residual
readout.mixture_scope: two global identity model parameters trained only by source CE
readout.initial_function: exact own scratch neural_residual_shallow; isolated new initialization RNG
readout.neural_shared_gain: one RMS over complex channels and time per packet
readout.relation_exit: biasfree Linear384to16 then biasfree Linear16to320; no activation
readout.readout_skip: complete original320 InvariantReadout retained independently in both paths

readout.readout_scope: one received packet; common finite lag window; no cross-packet statistics/state
readout.relation_gain_property: positive whole-projected-branch gain invariance above floors
readout.gain_property_scope: relation statistics after projections only; not the whole model or arbitrary physical channel

readout.invariant_readout: logpower mean/std,lag1/2 normalized complex correlation,4 positional logpower means
readout.interpretation: Received relative filter/polynomial energy is retained by normalization;not recovered TX PA/IQ coefficients or arbitrary RX/channel invariance
readout.normalization_scope: one complex power mean across all channels and time per packet per block
readout.relative_energy_after_gate: may change through learned radial gate;not fixed
readout.waveform_operator: x[n]exp(-j alpha omega n);raw variant returns x exactly
readout.alignment_interpretation: fixed received frequency retention;not TX/RX oscillator proportion
readout.behavior_input: lag4 envelope control plus signed tanh-gated delayed cubic residual
readout.mixture_scope: two global identity model parameters trained only by source CE
readout.initial_function: exact own scratch neural_residual_shallow; isolated new initialization RNG
readout.neural_shared_gain: one RMS over complex channels and time per packet
readout.relation_exit: biasfree Linear384to16 then biasfree Linear16to320; no activation
readout.readout_skip: complete original320 InvariantReadout retained independently in both paths

readout.readout_scope: one received packet; common finite lag window; no cross-packet statistics/state
readout.relation_gain_property: positive whole-projected-branch gain invariance above floors
readout.gain_property_scope: relation statistics after projections only; not the whole model or arbitrary physical channel

readout.invariant_readout: logpower mean/std,lag1/2 normalized complex correlation,4 positional logpower means
readout.interpretation: Received relative filter/polynomial energy is retained by normalization;not recovered TX PA/IQ coefficients or arbitrary RX/channel invariance
readout.normalization_scope: one complex power mean across all channels and time per packet per block
readout.relative_energy_after_gate: may change through learned radial gate;not fixed
readout.waveform_operator: x[n]exp(-j alpha omega n);raw variant returns x exactly
readout.alignment_interpretation: fixed received frequency retention;not TX/RX oscillator proportion
readout.behavior_input: lag4 envelope control plus signed tanh-gated delayed cubic residual
readout.mixture_scope: two global identity model parameters trained only by source CE
readout.initial_function: exact own scratch neural_residual_shallow; isolated new initialization RNG
readout.neural_shared_gain: one RMS over complex channels and time per packet
readout.relation_exit: biasfree Linear384to16 then biasfree Linear16to320; no activation
readout.readout_skip: complete original320 InvariantReadout retained independently in both paths
readout.readout_exit_initialization: zero final projection; random earlier projections
readout.readout_scope: one received packet; common finite lag window; no cross-packet statistics/state
readout.relation_gain_property: positive per-projected-channel gain invariance above floors
readout.gain_property_scope: relation statistics after projections only; not the whole model or arbitrary physical channel

readout.readout_scope: one received packet; common finite lag window; no cross-packet statistics/state

readout.gain_property_scope: relation statistics after projections only; not the whole model or arbitrary physical channel
